actual: The unified design requires Phase 2 implementation before branch integration can continue. Current code still has separated execution paths that must be unified through a shared adapter before final validation.
closure_requirements: Implement shared UnifiedMiniQMTVnpyExecutionAdapter/trading-core adapter semantics for vn.py-style child-order actions.
Wire Paper v2 MiniQMT single-strategy execution and MiniQMT virtual-strategy multi-strategy bridge to the shared adapter without divergent semantics.
Prove Sniper, BestLimit, and TWAP-lite fail-fast config validation, source attribution, policy id/hash, parent intent, child order id/action, and raw diagnostics.
Prove BUG-198 submit/cancel timeout diagnostics and prior exclusive_account fixes are inherited in the unified path.
Run required targeted tests and workflow finish/PR gates; keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: Phase 2 of docs/architecture/paper_v2_miniqmt_unified_autorun_design_20260602.md: implement the unified vn.py-style shared execution adapter on the MiniQMT unified integration branch, not main. This must satisfy F2M-04/P2M-03 and design sections 11.3, 11.4, and 14.2: Paper v2 exclusive-account and MiniQMT virtual-strategy multi-strategy execution must share one child-order/action generation adapter; Sniper, BestLimit, and TWAP-lite must preserve source attribution, parent intent, policy id/hash, child order diagnostics, raw broker diagnostics, and fail-fast unsupported config behavior; BUG-198 timeout/diagnostics and all accepted exclusive_account fixes must remain inherited; do not import vn.py EventEngine/MainEngine/gateway runtime and do not deliver any simplified/POC/minimum viable subset.
